All finite cases are actually enumerated with integer arithmetic, not sampled.

value.rationale: The permutation-matrix set is a canonical rank-one orbit in the additive 25-dimensional Boolean matrix group. Its exact full Walsh spectrum is a sharp natural Fourier-analysis invariant, not an arbitrary sparse Boolean function; the ℓ¹/ℓ∞ projection norm equals the first absolute moment of signed random 5-by-5 permanents. The exact 8-level spectrum supplies zero probability and full Fourier-kernel support as natural independent invariants not determined by previously available existence, extremal, or second-moment statements. The exhaustive fifth-order benchmark tests signed-permanent and Fourier spectra calculations; no general n statement is asserted.
